fields.observed_at: When the evidence was observed by the system.
fields.valid_from: Earliest time the claim is intended to apply.

rules: Never substitute assertion time for event time.
Never treat an observation as current without checking validity.
A claim with valid_until before as_of is STALE.
Two current claims for the same subject with materially different assertions are CONFLICTED until governed resolution.
Historical evidence remains historical; time does not silently promote it to current truth.
